description:
List recent enquiries (leads) for YOUR agency's CRM - newest first.
Use when the agent asks what has just come in (e.g. "what came in
today?").

This is the enquiry inbox: an enquiry that arrived from the portal,
a website or a microsite. Once an agent starts working a person
they live on a pipeline board instead - for those, use my_pipeline.
An agency that works everything off the boards can have a busy CRM
and an empty inbox here, which is not the same as having no leads.

Requires a linked PropertyList account (or an agency API key); only
ever returns the calling agency's own leads.

property_reference.description: Only leads about this listing reference. Optional.

since.description: ISO date/time - only leads created on or after this. Optional.

name: my_leads
title: My leads
